command.description: Default user request; --command can replace it without changing source permissions.

repository.description: Public owner/name resolved to a commit for repository-source collection.

sources.description: The source collector refuses endpoints outside these hosts.

specialists.description: At most sixteen agents may execute, including the master and all descendants.

Example.description: Scenario input. Runtime validation also checks unique IDs, source references and the total tree size.

id.description: Stable citation ID, unique within its scenario.

url.description: HTTPS URL; repository templates may use {repo} and {commit}.

links.description: Sample at most two same-host links after collecting the page.

format.description: Select a bounded adapter for structured research data instead of HTML extraction.

SourceSpec.description: One permitted public endpoint; URL templates are expanded only by the source collector.

researchers.description: A specialist cannot create extra researchers through model output.

Specialist.description: Parent agent that plans and synthesizes the work of its fixed researchers.

sourceIds.description: References SourceSpec IDs from the same scenario.

Researcher.description: Leaf agent with an explicit source scope; a model-generated task cannot expand it.
